name: GitHub App
blurb: An installation token of your GitHub App: an hour, no person's, narrowed by the App's installation.
guide: Create a GitHub App (github.com/settings/apps) with only the permissions the agent needs, and install it on only the repositories it works on.
Its installation id is in the URL of the installation's Configure page: github.com/settings/installations/ID.

Give a command that prints the App's private key on this machine, from where you keep it (a password manager, a file only you read). MWT signs a JWT with it as the App and trades it for an installation token, which lasts an hour; the key never leaves this machine.

fill.name: app_id
fill.label: The App's client id or app id

fill.name: key_command
fill.label: A command that prints the App's private key

grant.purpose: GitHub, as my App: gh, git over HTTPS and the GitHub API, on the repositories its installation selects.
